label: Lower after rewarded trials, higher after S1 / unrewarded, at D1 and GO
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * value
explanation: Raw update gate z of unit 27 is dominated by timing (it is near 1 early in the episode and decays toward 0 late, most at D1/GO; timing alone R^2 0.89). Beyond timing, the last trial drives it at D1 and GO only (D2 has almost no residual). At D1 it is lowered by a rewarded last trial (strongest after a rewarded S2: a1 S2 r, a2 S2 r about -0.12 to -0.13) and raised when the last reached state was S1, most of all after unrewarded S1 (a1 S1 u +0.19). At GO it is lowered by a previous reward (most after a1 rewarded) and raised after a previous a2 choice. A small positive D1 value term adds a little. The trial before, rewards summed over earlier trials, and late-episode scaling of these terms added nothing. Test R^2 beyond timing 0.55 (dev 0.55), 83% of the all-cues ceiling 0.66 (last trial alone 0.58).

issues: The D1 claim that last reaching S1 raises the gate is wrong after a rare rewarded trial. The profile's D1 residual for a2 S1 r is -0.053, against +0.058 for a1 S1 r and +0.186 for a1 S1 u. Misses on the claimed terms put D1 after a2 S1 r as the largest systematic over-prediction, at -0.092. Adding one term, (phase==D1)*last a2 S1 r, lifts test R^2 beyond timing from 0.548 to 0.572.

At D1 the real pattern is an action x state x reward interaction, not a reward effect plus an S1 effect. Residuals: a1S1r +0.058, a1S1u +0.186, a1S2r -0.121, a1S2u +0.051, a2S2r -0.134, a2S2u +0.030, a2S1r -0.053, a2S1u +0.096. Unrewarded trials raise the gate, more after reaching S1. Rewarded trials lower it, except a common rewarded a1 S1 trial, which raises it slightly.

At GO, 'a previous a2 choice raises it' holds only after unrewarded trials: a2S2u +0.068 and a2S1u +0.118, but a2S2r -0.007 and a2S1r -0.002. The rewarded-trial drop is really specific to a1 (a1S1r -0.064, a1S2r -0.096). Remaining GO misses with the claimed terms: under-predicted after a1 S1 u (+0.058) and a2 S1 u (+0.046).

The claim that scaling up late in the episode added nothing holds only for reward-only scaling (0.527, no gain). Scaling the full last-trial tables by ep_dec and ep_dec^2 raises test R^2 from 0.577 to 0.611, so the last-trial effect does change over the episode.
The value term is real but small: dropping it takes test R^2 from 0.548 to 0.524. No future variables are used, as claimed.

The claimed terms reach 0.548 on test, below the plain last-trial reference of 0.58. A better set of 8 terms reaches 0.621, close to the all-observed ceiling of 0.63, and its misses fall to |0.02| or less in every phase x previous-trial cell.
